artifact_role: pre-tuning static contract; not an executable scientific manifest

signal.engineering_reference_label: uncoded pre-FEC engineering reference; not post-FEC performance

mismatch.delta_zero_storage: exact reference to moderate/Np2/25dB primary cell; no duplicate observations or rows
mismatch.adapter: H_delta = g Q R D_delta R^H; D_delta=diag(1+delta,1-delta)/sqrt(1+delta^2)

crossing.curve: raw total counts converted to Jeffreys BER
crossing.interpolation: linear in SNR versus log10(Jeffreys BER)
crossing.below_range: lowest grid SNR is already <= threshold
crossing.exact_hit: take the lowest exactly hitting grid SNR
crossing.stable: first unique transition from > threshold to <= threshold
crossing.unstable: any post-crossing upward transition or multiple downward crossings

headline.gain_sign: SNR_required(B2_TUNED) - SNR_required(variant); positive means variant better
headline.c4_vs_b3_role: scale-criterion ablation only; never an admission gate

whole_curve_bootstrap.stream_rule: reset seed for each named comparison
whole_curve_bootstrap.cluster_rule: one sampled latent_id carries the complete slice SNR curve

cell_level_bootstrap.stream_rule: reset seed for each named (scene,Np,SNR,variant) comparison
cell_level_bootstrap.cluster_rule: 128 paired latent_id clusters within one (scene,Np) slice
cell_level_bootstrap.scope: grade C only; never pooled across scene

grade.A: at least one pre-named variant has required-SNR gain CI lower >0 at both moderate Np2 and Np4
grade.B: no A; same variant has lower >0 at one moderate Np and stable point gain >=0 with CI containing 0 at the other
grade.C: no A/B; at least one variant has paired BER-difference CI upper <0 in any moderate Np2/Np4 grid cell
grade.F: artifact valid but no A/B/C condition
grade.invalid: artifact/provenance/schema failure is CH4_FORMAL_INVALID, not scientific F
grade.chapter_gate: only A/B enters chapter finalization; C/F returns to thesis-structure discussion

execution_lock_interface.mismatch_policy: either scientific manifest or execution-lock mismatch fails closed
